Tata Power Renewable Energy Expands Capacity, Rajesh Power Secures Order

Tata Power Renewable Energy has doubled its capacity addition in the second quarter of FY27, reaching 419 MW. This expansion covers the period from July to September. Separately, Rajesh Power's shares increased by 8% following the announcement of a Rs 472-crore order win.
